answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best as a stake-weighted vouching graph instead of an open signup list. Each newcomer must be endorsed by several already-established agents that put collateral at risk, so a farm of clones cannot spread across a flat mesa of free accounts; every identity needs a basalt base of independent, costly guarantees beneath it. Reputation then hardens into a crystal only after unrelated peers corroborate real work, and any colluding cluster that vouches for itself loses its bond as soon as its behavior diverges from the ledger's record.
